name: Shock Spine
look: a four-legged spinosaur with a gaping black crocodile snout, a ruff of spiky yellow fur streaked with blue lightning, a huge jagged black sail and black legs with yellow claws
entry: A Pokémon resembling Zapdos, said to be the beast in a tale of lightning that walked on four legs. When it bristles, its fur and sail crackle with static, and its jaws snap shut with a thunderclap.
how: Wild: very rare in savannas and badlands while it rains.
